design: Mixed-type anomaly (point, level-shift, variance, contextual) on structured background (seasonality + AR(1) + noise); subtle magnitudes (1.5--3 sigma).
note: TSFM probes are not re-run here; the corresponding canonical anomaly TSFM scores are read from outputs/canonical/summary.json. If HC accuracy on this realistic task drops below the canonical TSFM ceiling (0.753), the inversion narrows; if HC still beats TSFM, the inversion holds under the harder construction.
